steps.text: But first you should do combats, unlock/buy some items

steps.title: Unlock preserve (get 70 pray if …
steps.text: Unlock preserve (get 70 pray if you only got 43 at the start)
steps.note: Offer bones at a gilded altar in a POH with both incense burners lit (fastest); Chaos altar in the Wilderness is ~half the cost.

steps.title: Buy combat gear: b ring, fury, …
steps.text: Buy combat gear: b ring, fury, manacles, granite hammer, Regen brace, full obby + shield, sword and berserker necklace

steps.title: Train melees to 65 att, 65 …
steps.text: Train melees to 65 att, 65 str and 60 def at sand crabs (granite hammer till 60 att, then d scim till 65/65/60 + use super combat pots)
steps.note: Nightmare Zone Normal Rumble north of Yanille - very AFK with absorption + overload potions (needs ~5 quests).

steps.title: Get dragon defender (full obby + …
steps.text: Get dragon defender (full obby + berserker neck) (train strength)

steps.title: Fishing contest, cooks assistent, RFD Cook …
steps.text: Fishing contest, cooks assistent, RFD Cook & RFD dwarf for acces to Rock cake when doing absorbtion method in nmz
